title: Polynomial-time promise distinguisher
statement: A polynomial-time map distinguishes a binary promise problem if it outputs the one-bit string $[\mathrm{true}]$ on every yes-instance and the one-bit string $[\mathrm{false}]$ on every no-instance. There is no condition on its outputs outside the promised sets.
hypotheses_covered: The decision map is polynomial-time computable
The problem is a binary promise problem
Every yes-instance maps to the one-bit string $[\mathrm{true}]$
Every no-instance maps to the one-bit string $[\mathrm{false}]$
